name: A1 - Source Adapter - Google Maps via Apify-v2

parameters.content:
The Actor is started asynchronously. The workflow persists provider
and dataset state, polls durably, reads bounded dataset pages, and
returns only normalized public business fields for the canonical
location supplied by the discovery orchestrator.

The request must contain location, location_key, source_scope_key,
max_results and source_policy_version. No default country, region or
city is applied by this workflow.

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_apify_jobs (
  run_id text NOT NULL
    REFERENCES a1_runs(run_id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  source_id text NOT NULL,
  segment text NOT NULL,
  request_key text NOT NULL,

  scope_key text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  location_key text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

  actor_id text NOT NULL,
  actor_name text NOT NULL,
  actor_build_tag text,
  actor_build_number text,
  actor_run_id text,
  dataset_id text,

  actor_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  job_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',

  actor_input jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,

  max_total_charge_usd numeric,
  usage_total_usd numeric,

  charged_event_counts jsonb
    NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,

  dataset_item_count integer
    NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  result_count integer
    NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  dataset_offset integer
    NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  dataset_exhausted boolean
    NOT NULL DEFAULT false,

  last_error text,
  started_at timestamptz,
  finished_at timestamptz,

  updated_at timestamptz
    NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  PRIMARY KEY (
    run_id,
    source_id,
    segment,
    request_key
  )
);

ALTER TABLE a1_apify_jobs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS
  scope_key text NOT NULL DEFAULT '';

ALTER TABLE a1_apify_jobs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS
  location_key text NOT NULL DEFAULT '';

ALTER TABLE a1_apify_jobs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS
  job_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING';

ALTER TABLE a1_apify_jobs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS
  dataset_offset integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

ALTER TABLE a1_apify_jobs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS
  dataset_exhausted boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
  a1_apify_jobs_actor_run_idx
ON a1_apify_jobs(actor_run_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
  a1_apify_jobs_source_scope_idx
ON a1_apify_jobs (
  source_id,
  scope_key,
  updated_at DESC
);

SELECT 1 AS schema_ready;

WITH request AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS run_id,
    $2::text AS source_id,
    $3::text AS segment,
    $4::text AS request_key,
    $5::jsonb AS request_payload,
    $6::text AS scope_key,
    $7::text AS location_key
),
policy AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE actor_status IN (
        'READY',
        'RUNNING',
        'TIMING-OUT',
        'ABORTING'
      )
      AND NOT (
        run_id = $1
        AND segment = $3
        AND request_key = $4
      )
    )::integer AS active_other_runs
  FROM a1_apify_jobs
  WHERE source_id = $2
)
SELECT
  request.request_payload,
  request.scope_key,
  request.location_key,

  (job.actor_run_id IS NOT NULL)
    AS existing_job_found,

  job.actor_run_id,
  job.dataset_id,
  job.actor_status,
  job.job_status,
  job.actor_build_number,
  job.usage_total_usd,

  COALESCE(
    job.charged_event_counts,
    '{}'::jsonb
  ) AS charged_event_counts,

  COALESCE(
    job.dataset_offset,
    0
  ) AS dataset_offset,

  COALESCE(
    job.dataset_exhausted,
    false
  ) AS dataset_exhausted,

  job.last_error,
  policy.active_other_runs

FROM request
CROSS JOIN policy

LEFT JOIN a1_apify_jobs job
  ON job.run_id = request.run_id
 AND job.source_id = request.source_id
 AND job.segment = request.segment
 AND job.request_key = request.request_key
 AND job.scope_key = request.scope_key;

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $json;

const error =
  item.policy_block_error || {
    code: 'SOURCE_POLICY_BLOCKED',
    message:
      'The Google Maps Actor run was blocked by source policy.',
    retryable: false,
    stage: 'policy'
  };

const existingCursor =
  item.previous_position &&
  Object.keys(item.previous_position).length
    ? item.previous_position
    : null;

const generatedCursor =
  item.actor_run_id || item.dataset_id
    ? {
        cursor_version: '1.2',
        source_id: item.source_id,
        segment: item.segment,
        location_key: item.location_key,
        scope_key: item.scope_key,
        mode: 'apify_dataset',

        state: {
          actor_run_id:
            item.actor_run_id || null,

          dataset_id:
            item.dataset_id || null,

          actor_status:
            item.actor_status || null,

          dataset_offset:
            Math.max(
              0,
              Number(item.dataset_offset || 0)
            ),

          dataset_exhausted:
            Boolean(item.dataset_exhausted)
        },

        source_exhausted:
          Boolean(item.dataset_exhausted),

        updated_at:
          new Date().toISOString()
      }
    : {};

return [{
  json: {
    contract_version:
      'a1.source-result.v1',

    run_id:
      item.run_id,

    source_job_id:
      item.source_job_id,

    source_id:
      item.source_id,

    platform_source_id:
      item.platform_source_id,

    adapter_id:
      item.source_id,

    source_name:
      item.source_name,

    source_type:
      'google_maps',

    segment:
      item.segment,

    location:
      item.location,

    requested_location:
      item.location,

    location_key:
      item.location_key,

    source_scope_key:
      item.source_scope_key,

    status:
      'blocked',

    source_exhausted:
      false,

    records:
      [],

    next_cursor:
      existingCursor || generatedCursor,

    summary: {
      raw_records: 0,
      normalized_records: 0,
      active_other_runs:
        item.active_other_runs || 0,
      planned_maximum_items:
        item.planned_maximum_items || 0,
      dataset_offset:
        item.dataset_offset || 0
    },

    warnings:
      item.validation_warnings || [],

    error,

    artifact_reference: {
      provider: 'apify',
      actor_id: item.actor_id,
      actor_name: item.actor_name,
      actor_run_id:
        item.actor_run_id || null,
      dataset_id:
        item.dataset_id || null,
      storage_uri:
        item.dataset_id
          ? `apify://datasets/${item.dataset_id}`
          : null
    },

    source_policy_id:
      item.source_policy_id,

    source_policy_version:
      item.source_policy_version,

    started_at:
      item.started_at,

    finished_at:
      new Date().toISOString()
  }
}];

const context =
  $('Decide Start or Resume').item.json;

const run = $json || {};

const message = run.error
  ? String(
      run.error?.message ||
      run.error
    )
  : '';

const ok =
  Boolean(run.id) &&
  !message;

return [{
  json: {
    ...context,

    actor_start_ok:
      ok,

    actor_started_this_execution:
      ok,

    actor_run_id:
      ok ? run.id : null,

    dataset_id:
      ok
        ? run.defaultDatasetId || null
        : null,

    actor_status:
      ok
        ? String(
            run.status || 'READY'
          ).toUpperCase()
        : 'START_FAILED',

    job_status:
      ok
        ? 'RUNNING'
        : 'FAILED',

    actor_build_number:
      ok
        ? run.buildNumber || null
        : null,

    dataset_offset:
      0,

    dataset_exhausted:
      false,

    actor_run_data:
      ok ? run : {},

    actor_error:
      ok
        ? null
        : {
            code:
              'APIFY_ACTOR_START_FAILED',

            message:
              message ||
              'Apify did not return an Actor run ID.',

            retryable:
              true,

            stage:
              'actor_start'
          }
  }
}];

const item =
  $json.normalized_payload ||
  $json;

const records =
  Array.isArray(item.parsed_records)
    ? item.parsed_records
    : [];

const error =
  item.parser_error || null;

const status =
  error
    ? (
        records.length
          ? 'partial'
          : 'failed'
      )
    : item.dataset_exhausted
      ? 'completed'
      : 'partial';

return [{
